findings.message: 2 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "I build the parts of systems that stay q…" → 7 lines at 31.7px; "Haris. I build the quiet parts of system…" → 5 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.

findings.message: 4 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.archive-row 520px | div.archive-row 520px | div.archive-row 520px | div.footer 1376px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (4.8:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: 28% of the first screen is one empty block (540×660px at 0,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 7 different lines (64px, 32px, 107px, 176px, 288px, 708px, 736px); the three most used hold only 56% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "I build the parts of systems that stay quiet whe" (screen 2, 100% hidden); "Work" (screen 3, 100% hidden); "Four sketches. None of them is finished. That is" (screen 5, 100% hidden); "ROUTE" (screen 6, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "hrisscloud@gmail.com" (screen 9, 100% over a picture); "ROUTE" (screen 6, 100% over a picture); "ISOLATE" (screen 7, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.
Check that it is a deliberate rest (once per page at most); otherwise close it to the normal section gap.

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("H RIS") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "hrisscloud@gmail.com" → 3 lines (1 words, 44.9px)
findings.fix:
